typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	CAERPTS_DATASOURCE as string (),
	CAERPTS_DB as string (),
	CAERPTS_PWD as string (),
	CAERPTS_USER as string (),
	MOBILE_DATASOURCE as string (),
	MOBILE_DB as string (),
	MOBILE_PWD as string (),
	MOBILE_USER as string (),
	OLTP_DATASOURCE as string (),
	OLTP_DB as string (),
	OLTP_PWD as string (),
	OLTP_USER as string (),
	v_Archive as string (),
	v_ExcelSQL as string (),
	v_FileExists as string (),
	v_IsArchive as integer (),
	v_MonthDecrement as integer (),
	v_SourceID as integer (),
	v_SRCFile as string (),
	v_SRCFileArchive as string (),
	v_SRCFileName as string (),
	v_SRCFilePath as string (),
	v_SRCFolder as string ()
}

source(output(
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		CALL_DATE as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> XLSMAHRACallAttempts	source(output(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		ATTEMPT_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT SUBSCRIBER_ID,ATTEMPT_DATE FROM APP_RPTS.MA_HRA_CALLATTEMPTS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY SUBSCRIBER_ID,ATTEMPT_DATE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPCALLATTEMPTSLKPTABLE
XLSMAHRACallAttempts derive(SUBSCRIBER_ID = substring(toString(MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER), toInteger(1), toInteger(9))) ~> DCSUBSCRIBERID
DCSUBSCRIBERID derive(DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID = toString(SUBSCRIBER_ID),
		DC_CALL_DATE = CALL_DATE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LKPCALLATTEMPTSLKPTABLE lookup(DC_CALL_DATE == ATTEMPT_DATE && DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID == LKPCALLATTEMPTSLKPTABLE@SUBSCRIBER_ID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPCALLATTEMPTS
LKPCALLATTEMPTS select(mapColumn(
		DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID = DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		DC_CALL_DATE = DC_CALL_DATE,
		CALL_DATE = CALL_DATE,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID = LKPCALLATTEMPTSLKPTABLE@SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER = MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,
		ATTEMPT_DATE = ATTEMPT_DATE
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPCALLATTEMPTSSelect
LKPCALLATTEMPTSSelect split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LKPCALLATTEMPTSIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LKPCALLATTEMPTSIsMatch@Match derive(EXIST = 1) ~> DCEXISTS
LKPCALLATTEMPTSIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		CALL_DATETIME as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALL_DATETIME = DC_CALL_DATE,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID = DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID)) ~> OLEDBCMINITIALOUTREACHSTAGE
DCEXISTS sink(input(
		CALL_DATETIME as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EXIST as boolean,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALL_DATETIME = DC_CALL_DATE,
		EXIST,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID = DC_SUBSCRIBER_ID)) ~> OLEDBCMINITIALOUTREACHSTAGEEXISTS
